skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create original posters, art prints, and visual design artifacts as PNG or PDF files using a structured design philosophy.
skill.summary: Create polished visual art and design artifacts from a written design philosophy.
skill.author: ComposioHQ

security_audit.summary: Most static findings in license text and Markdown formatting are false positives. The bundled TTF font files remain low-severity confirmed because they are binary assets that require provenance and integrity review. A semantic prompt-injection issue was identified where the skill fabricates a prior user request during the final refinement step.

remediation.issue: The final-step instruction claims the user already requested a museum-quality refinement.
remediation.suggestion: Rewrite the line to say the skill should perform a quality pass only when consistent with the current user request.

remediation.issue: Bundled TTF font files cannot be reviewed by text-only static analysis.
remediation.suggestion: Document font provenance, licenses, and checksums, and scan or verify the binaries before publication.

content.value_statement: Static design requests often need a strong concept before visual execution. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to create a design philosophy and express it as polished PNG or PDF artwork.
actual_capabilities: Creates a written visual design philosophy before rendering the final artifact.
Guides production of single-page PNG or PDF visual artwork.
Emphasizes original composition, typography, spacing, color, and visual hierarchy.
Uses bundled local fonts from the canvas-fonts directory for typography choices.
Supports multi-page visual sets when the user requests additional pages.
limitations: Focused on static visual artifacts, not interactive websites or applications.
Requires an execution environment that can create PNG or PDF files.
Bundled fonts should be reviewed for provenance before marketplace publication.
Does not guarantee print-production specifications such as bleed, CMYK, or press profiles.

use_cases.title: Design a poster concept
use_cases.description: Turn a short campaign idea into a polished one-page poster with a clear visual philosophy.

use_cases.title: Create abstract event artwork
use_cases.description: Produce a refined PNG or PDF art piece that communicates a subtle theme through form and color.

use_cases.title: Explore visual directions
use_cases.description: Generate an aesthetic movement and use it to guide a consistent set of static design pages.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single visual artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page PNG poster for a quiet morning coffee event. Use minimal text and a warm visual philosophy.

prompt_templates.title: Design a brand art piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with style and output constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PDF art piece for a small ceramics studio. Make it restrained, tactile, and design-forward with sparse typography.

prompt_templates.title: Build a subtle reference poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs an embedded concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an abstract poster that quietly references lunar navigation without literal moons or spacecraft. Output the philosophy and PNG.

prompt_templates.title: Create a multi-page visual set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a cohesive series.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-page PDF visual series for an experimental music festival. Each page should share a philosophy but feel distinct.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for a botanical lecture series.
output_examples.output: A concise design philosophy describing organic systems, restrained color, and spatial hierarchy, followed by a polished one-page poster PDF.

output_examples.input: Make abstract artwork for a film night about memory.
output: A visual philosophy centered on layered traces and quiet repetition.
A PNG artwork with sparse type, subtle reference markers, and a cohesive limited palette.

output_examples.input: Create a premium event flyer with almost no text.
output_examples.output: A design-forward flyer that uses typography as a visual element and communicates most information through composition.

best_practices: Provide the subject, desired mood, output format, and any required text before generation.
Ask for one strong direction first, then request refinement of spacing, hierarchy, and polish.
Review final PNG or PDF files for text boundaries, overlap, margins, and readability.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to copy a living artist or a protected brand style.
Do not use it for interactive UI flows, animations, or production web components.
Do not overload the artifact with long paragraphs when the skill is optimized for visual-first work.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates static visual design artifacts, usually PNG or PDF files, guided by a written design philosophy.

faq.question: Can it create multi-page designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports additional pages when requested, while keeping a shared visual direction across the set.

faq.question: Does it write long marketing copy?
faq.answer: No. It favors sparse, essential text that supports the visual composition.

faq.question: Can I use my own required text?
faq.answer: Yes. Include exact words, dates, names, or labels in the prompt so they can be placed intentionally.

faq.question: Does it use local fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill directs the assistant to search the included canvas-fonts directory for typography choices.

faq.question: Is it ready for print production?
faq.answer: It can create strong visual drafts, but final print checks like bleed, color profile, and resolution remain the user's responsibility.
